check_service_status.description: Check whether The Quotes Hub is answering, and how quickly. This is the one action that reports a problem as a value instead of failing the step, so a workflow can branch on it and fall back to a saved quote when the service is down. Being throttled is reported separately from being down. No API key required.
check_service_status.display_str_template: Check whether The Quotes Hub is up.

mock_response.message: The Quotes Hub is up and serving quotes.

check_service_status.name: check_service_status

message.description: What happened, in a sentence worth posting.

online.description: True when the service answered with a quote. This is the field to branch on.

rate_limited.description: True when the answer was a throttle (HTTP 429). Being throttled is not the same as being down.

reachable.description: True when something answered at all, even with an error. False means the request never landed.

response_time_ms.description: How long the request took, in milliseconds, or null when nothing came back.

status_code.description: The HTTP status that came back, or null when nothing did.

description: Quotations from The Quotes Hub: a random quote for a daily message or a newsletter sign-off, the whole collection a page at a time, one quote by its number, and quotes gathered by tag or by author. Tags and authors come with their own listings and quote counts, so a workflow can pick a theme or a voice and pull from it. Every quote carries its author, its tags and a link to itself. No account or API key required.
